    Town Management

    Admin only. Bacarra, Vintar, Pasuquin, and MB towns are loaded from the approved town list. MB towns have their own dashboard section but are classified under Pasuquin for parcel matching. Each town is matched individually; Zone ID validation is disabled. Removing a town can cause matching parcels to be marked Misrouted.
